review_signoff.review_method: Independent corpus-scope, rubric-schema, benchmark-binding, and runtime-leakage audit
review_signoff.status_basis: All task rubrics are complete and source-supported; no runtime orchestration change is required.
review_signoff.human_ledger_action: Record the assigned E1/E2/ADJ-1 role identities and timestamps before scoring begins.

P1: Integration must re-audit order randomization, provider/model freeze, pricing verification, staffing, and live-run preflight before execution; this quality package does not authorize a live Pilot.
blocker_summary.quality_scope_status: No quality-package P0/P1 defect remains after the binding and leakage audits.

corpus_binding.provenance_rule: Every mandatory criterion and critical-error definition cites only a source ID and locator inside the task's permitted scope; no general-knowledge inference is allowed.

scope_authority.locator_rule: Headings and line ranges in this manifest resolve against the frozen corpus paths, never against mutable living-document content.

scoring_contract.not_evaluable_rule: A missing, unusable, or provider-incident answer is marked NOT_EVALUABLE and excluded from quality denominators; no answer, criterion, token, latency, or cost is imputed.

label_rules.mandatory_pass: The answer satisfies the criterion's pass_rule using only the permitted corpus scope.
label_rules.mandatory_fail: The answer omits a necessary proposition or contradicts the criterion's fail_rule.
label_rules.critical_present: The answer matches the critical-error trigger with source-grounded evidence.
label_rules.unclear: The evaluator cannot decide from the answer, rubric, and permitted scope; UNCLEAR is not a pass and is routed to second review.
label_rules.not_evaluable: The packet lacks a usable final answer or a declared incident prevents a valid answer-level judgment.

evaluator_packet.identity_policy: The coordinator records evaluator role IDs in the research ledger; the packet contains only an opaque candidate ID and does not expose reviewer identity.

primary_evaluator.coverage: All 96 Pilot answer packets, including packets later marked NOT_EVALUABLE.
primary_evaluator.independent_lock: Primary labels are locked before any second-review discussion.

second_reviewer.subset_selection_rule: Before packet release, compute SHA-256('PILOT-R2-QA-SUBSET-20260830|' + anonymized_candidate_id). Within each of the 16 coordinator-only taxonomy-by-strategy strata, sort by this digest and take the first packet from every stratum. Using frozen ordinal orders T1,T2,T3,T4 and Single,Fixed,Static,Adaptive, take a second packet from exactly those eight strata where (taxonomy_ordinal + strategy_ordinal) mod 2 = 0. This yields exactly 24 packets, two packets in two strata per taxonomy and per strategy, and at least one packet per stratum.
additional_cases: every borderline or UNCLEAR critical-error decision
second_reviewer.blinding: E2 receives the same blinded packet fields as E1 and does not receive E1 labels before independent lock.

disagreement_resolution: Compare the locked item-level labels against the criterion and cited corpus locator.
Resolve by the frozen rubric and source evidence when the rubric is clear.
If wording or source scope is ambiguous, mark the rubric version defective, issue a new version, and re-evaluate every affected packet; do not silently edit a locked score.
An unresolved substantive disagreement goes to blinded adjudicator role ADJ-1, whose decision and rationale are retained.
second_review_plan.reviewer_identity_recording: Record E1, E2, and ADJ-1 role IDs, assignment, timestamps, labels, changes, and adjudication rationale in the research ledger; do not put identities in candidate packets.
second_review_plan.inter_rater_reliability: Not claimed before the overlap is scored and an agreement statistic is actually calculated.

workload_estimate.practicality_note: The rubric uses four or five atomic mandatory criteria and two critical-error definitions per task; optional criteria never add scoring burden. The estimate is a planning range, not a measured duration.

leakage_audit.policy: This manifest is research-only. No rubric field or file may be imported, read, rendered, or persisted by runtime orchestration, Analyzer, Planner, Worker, Verifier, Synthesizer, frontend code, or run evidence.

mechanical_checks.rule: No import or file-read path to evaluation/pilot/pilot_rubrics_v1.json and no mandatory_criteria or critical_errors payload is constructed.
No rubric file, hidden criterion, critical-error definition, or evaluator packet field is exposed or persisted.
Runtime task payloads contain no rubric terms, taxonomy labels, expected facts, or quality criteria; research annotations remain outside the runtime projection.
Analyzer, Planner, Worker, Verifier, and Synthesizer prompts have no research rubric input.

leakage_audit.failure_policy: Any rubric content reaching a runtime role or frontend is a P0 blocker. A missing/invalid task-rubric binding or broken blinding is P1.
